question.prompt: When using the converse of the Pythagorean theorem to determine whether a triangle is a right triangle, which side should be taken as the hypotenuse when checking \(a^2+b^2=c^2\)?

solutions.explanation: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle, so compare the square of the longest side with the sum of the squares of the other two sides.
solutions.title: Identify the candidate hypotenuse
